We’re immensely proud of our colleagues and partners who have been recognised for their exceptional service to the UK.

Huge congratulations to:

🎖️ Mark Beddy, our former Trustee and Chair of the Finance Committee, on receiving an Honorary OBE for services to Arts and Culture in the UK

🎖️ Zhanna Sevastianova, on receiving an Honorary MBE for services in support of UK/Ukraine cultural relations. As the Head of English and School Education at uabritish, Zhanna contributes to teacher growth and empowerment, promoting trauma-sensitive teaching and learning, supporting English language and life skills development by fostering cultural connections.

We’re immensely proud of Lyubov Kostova, who has been awarded the Honorary British Empire Medal by His Majesty King Charles III for services to UK science and education.

Lyubov is a long-time collaborator and former leader at the British Council in Bulgaria. As the founder of the Sofia Science Festival and the driving force behind the international success of FameLab, she has inspired thousands by making science more accessible and engaging.

Congratulations, Lyubov! 🎖️

📸 His Excellency Nathaniel Copsey, British Ambassador to Bulgaria, presenting the award to Lyubov Kostova.

If you’re in London, check out the new exhibition at our Stratford office. New Landscapes is a research and development partnership supporting transnational small to medium business partnerships, helping to tackle fashion, textiles and related technology sustainability challenges. 

Visit the exhibition to explore novel materials, products and services, including bio-derived embellishments, regenerative desi cotton underwear, and an app keeping India’s rich regional mending heritage in touch with customers. 

Pop in if you’re visiting the V&A East Museum to see the new #DavidBowie Centre, we’re just down the road!

Location: Ground Floor, 1 Redman Place, Stratford Cross, London E20 1JQ

Opening dates: 12 September 2025 - 30 January 2026 

Opening times: 09:00-17:00, Monday - Friday

The first episode of our #OurWorldConnectedPodcast Season 2 mini series is out! Host Christine Wilson revisits inspiring conversations, exploring how technology is shaping the way we live, learn, and connect. 

We share previously unheard material from guests Baroness Beebon Kidron, a digital child rights activist, renowned linguist and author David Crystal and Larisa Halilovic, Team Leader of the UK-Government funded programme, Western Balkans Media for Change.
 
The episode uncovers insights concerning key questions of our times: 
✨what does the emerging digital world mean for young people growing up? 
✨how can technology be designed and further regulated — including the responsibilities of governments, educators, and tech companies in keeping young people safe online? 

🎧 Listen now: https://www.britishcouncil.org/research-insight/our-world-connected-podcast/rewired-how-technology-is-changing-us-all

The UK will take centre stage as Guest of Honour at the 53rd edition of the Festival Internacional Cervantino in Mexico!

The special moment arrives a full decade after the UK-MX Dual Year (The Year of the UK in Mexico and The Year of Mexico in the UK), reaffirming a long-term commitment to foster mutual understanding and support sustainable cultural exchange.
 
The British Council’s relationship with Cervantino began in 2015 and has evolved from collaboration to long-term transformation, contributing to a new model for cultural festivals, placing audiences at their heart and highlighting the role of culture in addressing global challenges.

👉Find out more about Cervantino 2025 via the link in our bio britishcouncil.
